occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: During the monitoring visit, there two sippy cups not labeled. During the visit, the director labeled two sippy cups that were not labeled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Label for Each Infant: During the monitoring visit, the playpens were not labeled with the children names. The director labeled the playpens during the visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(I))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During the visit, there were several lose cords behind the director's desk on the floor. The outlets were uncovered on the wall. Hand sanitizer was accessible to children. There was a dirty diaper on the floor behind the desk. Upon arrival, the table had old food and food on the carpet, with empty water bottles on the floor.  The director wiped the tables and vacuumed the floor during the visit. All these items including the director desk area was accessible to the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: During the monitoring visit two caregiver did not have a current first aid or cpr certificate available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours: One out of four caregivers did not have annual hours available for review.   Annual training hours from two caregivers were missing the following topics:   Child growth and development, Guidance and discipline ,Age-appropriate curriculum ,Teacher-child interaction, child maltreatment, safe sleep, shaken baby syndrome, early childhood brain development, emergency preparedness, medication, food allergies, understanding building and physical premises, handling and storing, and preventing controlling the spread of diseases, and remaining topics to complete 24 hours. A detail list was provided for each caregiver to the operation for trainings that is required specifically for the individual.   .
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours (26 TAC §746.901(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: The operations staff were missing several items from their personal files, whether electronic or on paper. The folders did not include copies of the education qualifications for three caregivers, a pre-employment affidavit for one caregiver, a complete notarized form available for review for one caregiver, and attendance records for four caregivers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: During the monitoring visit, the was garbage accessible to children. The children are able to put their hands in the garbage to pull out used items such as diapers, pull ups, and tissue.. In the restroom there was a used pull-up on the floor.The trash was removed and the pull up was removed from the floor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: During the monitoring visit, the classroom had ceiling tiles that were damaged during the visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During the monitoring visit, there was a damaged table in the classroom, and on the playground, there were damaged toys with sharp edges. Also the outdoors has several toys that need to be removed from the playground for children's safety.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Equipment and Water Hoses Kept Out of Child's Reach: During the monitoring visit, there was an exposed water hose on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Equipment and Water Hoses Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §746.5015(c))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Two out of three did not have personal records available for review during the monitor visit. The records not available were attendance sheets for employees, affidavits forms, criminal background checks, and ID.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over: During the monitoring visit, there was a television sitting on a table. The television was not anchored to the wall or stand. The television was removed from the table during the visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over (26 TAC §746.3701(10))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation did not have an up-to-date annual sanitation inspection available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: During the monitoring visit, the operation did not have a current fire inspection available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Two out of three did not have annual training records available for review during the monitor visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies: Five out of eight children did not have a copy of the parent handbook signed by the parent available for review during the monitoring visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies (26 TAC §746.503)

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: During the monitoring visit, the CPR first aid had expired for two coworkers in March. Three half-size certificates for CPR/first aid were provided with the names of each individual handwritten.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Three children did not have the straps on while in the chair with the table attached during the monitoring visit. During the visit, the caregiver applied the straps to each child at the table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: During the monitoring visit, the CPR first aid had expired for two coworkers in March. Three half-size certificates for CPR/first aid were provided with the names of each individual handwritten.

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records: The operation provided a playground/daily checklist that was last dated in August 2024 during the monitoring visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: During the monitoring visit, the operation did not have up-to-date shot records for five children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets: The playard in the infant classroom did not have a fitted sheet, and there was spilled milk on the playyard mat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: During the monitoring visit, the handbook provided by email did not have the support for inclusion services in the parent handbook.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary: During the monitoring visit, the kitchen was not cleaned properly. The dishes were sitting in dirty water. The stove was not cleaned. Cabinets were broken, and the refrigerator had a canned item that had been opened with a utensil inside during the monitoring visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §746.3317)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): Two caregivers did not have the affidavit form completed during the monitoring visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The cots in the classroom are damaged. The edges on the cot are broken. The operation also had mats that were damaged, but the owner removed mats from the classroom area. The floor in the classroom had lots of food on the floor during the monitor visit. A caregiver vacuumed the food off the floor during the visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: The toddler room had a baby walker in the classroom with wheels. The operation removed the baby walker from the classroom to the front porch in order to be thrown out with trash.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers (26 TAC §746.2415(a)(1))
